fields.Name: T297 - Integrations Create Tables Panel
fields.Description: Exercises the ToggleCreateTablesPanel batch source-object selector (FilteredCreateTablesObjects + select-all + per-object checkboxes) — a distinct checkbox-list interaction unlike the schema-dropdown Auto-Map or single-object Add-Map.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, find and open the Integrations application, and open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. Click a connection card body to open its detail view, then click the 'Create Tables' button in the entity-maps toolbar. Verify an inline panel opens for selecting source objects to create as entity tables, showing a search box, a 'Select All (X of Y)' checkbox, and a checkbox list of source objects (or a clear 'No source objects available' message). Type in the search box and confirm the object list narrows. Do NOT click Create Tables. Seeing the source-object selection panel render and respond to search is success. If no connection exists, a clear empty state is acceptable. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking Create Tables opens a panel with a search box and a Select All checkbox above a source-object checkbox list (or a clear 'no source objects' message)
Typing in the search narrows the source-object list when objects are present
The panel is only inspected, not executed
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
